deltaFindings.title: Staged Review 未沿用已驗證的 Context (§3.3.4 Dual Visibility)
deltaFindings.issue: Staged fallback (executeStagedReview / executeChunk) was rebuilding context independently rather than forwarding caller-provided exact-head contextPackage and contextGaps, breaking §3.3.4 Dual Visibility identical contextual enclosure invariant.
deltaFindings.remediation: executeStagedReview and executeChunk now forward caller-provided contextPackage and effectiveContextGaps through to prompt assembly and chunk adapter calls, ensuring identical enclosures between primary sentries and Clean Challenge verifier. Fail-closed behavior enforced on context absence or inconsistency.

deltaFindings.title: executeStagedReview 在 contextPackage 為 null/falsy 時繞過重新擷取 (§3.3.4 Dual Visibility)
deltaFindings.issue: staged-review.mjs 以 callerContextPackage !== undefined 判斷是否沿用外部 Context，當明確傳入 null 且無 EXACT_HEAD_CONTEXT_FAILED 時略過 buildContextPackage 重新擷取，導致缺少必要 Context 與不確定性提示即進入 Chunk Review。
deltaFindings.remediation: executeStagedReview 強化 callerContextPackage 驗證，僅在有效非空物件時直接沿用；若為 null/undefined 且無 extraction gap 則強制呼叫 buildContextPackage 重新擷取有效 exact-head contextPackage。若擷取失敗或 exact-head 不可用，則傳播 EXACT_HEAD_CONTEXT_FAILED 不確定性 gap 並阻止 Clean Approval。

deltaFindings.title: 三方 Staged 遙測歸屬錯誤 (dogfood-review.mjs providerTelemetry)
deltaFindings.issue: dogfood-review.mjs 將全域 stagedFallbackUsed 寫給 agy，並將 claude、codex 固定為 false，導致單一 Provider (如 Claude) 觸發 Staged Fallback 時遙測歸屬錯誤。
deltaFindings.remediation: 分別追蹤 agyStagedFallbackUsed, claudeStagedFallbackUsed, codexStagedFallbackUsed，並如實填入 providerTelemetry[provider].stagedFallbackUsed。
